# Cadence UI

> Animation-first React components for shadcn. Base UI + Tailwind CSS v4 + Motion.
> Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/<id>`. Every component ships its motion contract and a reduced-motion branch.

## Install

```json
{ "registries": { "@cadence": "https://cadence.dev/r/{name}.json" } }
```

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/button
```

## Rules for agents

- Prefer an existing Cadence component over writing new animation code.
- Read the item's `docs` and `meta.motion` before changing motion.
- Keep the reduced-motion branch; never remove `data-motion`.
- Use presets from `components/cadence/lib/motion.ts`; do not invent durations.
- Cadence is UI only: never pass a schema, resolver, or validation rule to a component (P11).

## Components

- [Button](/r/button.md): Triggers an action, with press feedback that collapses under reduced motion. (form, feedback)
- [Badge](/r/badge.md): A compact status label that stays still while the content around it animates. (feedback)
- [Kbd](/r/kbd.md): A keyboard key or shortcut hint, styled from the semantic tokens. (utility)
- [Separator](/r/separator.md): A one-pixel rule that divides groups of content. (layout)
- [Label](/r/label.md): An accessible name for a form control, with no state of its own. (form)
- [Input](/r/input.md): A single-line text field whose invalid state is driven by aria-invalid. (form)
- [Textarea](/r/textarea.md): A multi-line text field that grows with its content instead of a script. (form)
- [Card](/r/card.md): A bounded surface for grouped content, with parts you can restyle. (layout)
- [Aspect Ratio](/r/aspect-ratio.md): Reserves a box at a fixed ratio so media cannot shift the layout. (layout)
- [Avatar](/r/avatar.md): A profile image with a text fallback, a presence dot, and a stack of peers. (data)
- [Skeleton](/r/skeleton.md): A placeholder pulse that marks where content will land. (feedback, data)
- [Alert](/r/alert.md): A message about the current state of the page, with an icon column and an action slot. (feedback)
- [Empty](/r/empty.md): The resting state of a region that has nothing to show yet. (feedback, layout)
- [Item](/r/item.md): A row in a list of like objects, with media, content, and actions. (data, layout)
- [Field](/r/field.md): A labelled control with its description and error, without owning validation. (form)
- [Button Group](/r/button-group.md): Adjacent controls joined into one shape. (form, layout)
- [Input Group](/r/input-group.md): A text control framed with prefixes, suffixes, and buttons. (form)
- [Breadcrumb](/r/breadcrumb.md): The trail from the root to the current page. (navigation)
- [Pagination](/r/pagination.md): Page navigation that stays a link, not a button. (navigation)
- [Spinner](/r/spinner.md): An indeterminate wait, rotating until the work finishes. (feedback)
- [Dialog](/r/dialog.md): A modal window that fades and settles in, with the open and close sequence interruptible. (overlay)
- [Checkbox](/r/checkbox.md): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked. (form)
- [Radio Group](/r/radio-group.md): A set of checkable buttons where no more than one can be checked at a time. (form)
- [Switch](/r/switch.md): A control that toggles between on and off, with a thumb that travels between the two states. (form)
- [Slider](/r/slider.md): An input where the user selects a value from a range by dragging a thumb. (form)
- [Toggle](/r/toggle.md): A two-state button that can be pressed or not pressed. (form)
- [Toggle Group](/r/toggle-group.md): A set of two-state buttons that can be pressed one at a time or together. (form)
- [Input OTP](/r/input-otp.md): A one-time password field that renders one slot per character. (form)
- [Progress](/r/progress.md): Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task. (feedback)

- [/r/catalog.json](/r/catalog.json): machine-readable catalog
